title: Hostel Facilities
content:
DAVIET provides separate hostel accommodation for boys and girls on campus. According to the official Hostels page:

- Hostels have attached mess; mess menu is decided by students; focus on nutritious and hygienic food.
- Campus has its own water supply and power backup; 24-hour hostel security.
- Recreation rooms with indoor sports, news room, cable TV and telephone facility.
- Computing/Internet facilities in the hostel computer lab (site mentions leased-line internet connectivity).
- Reading room for late-night studies; attached playgrounds.
- Resident doctor for student healthcare; washerman visits for laundry/dry cleaning.
- Canteen and mess tuck-shop for grocery and other items.
- Basic amenities such as hot water and water coolers.
- Ultra-modern lift in the boys hostel.
- AC accommodation is available in Sutlej Hostel on a first-come, first-served basis.

Hostel names referenced elsewhere on the site include Sutlej Hostel (boys), Beas Hostel, and Raavi (Girls) Hostel. For fee structure and rules, see the Hostels section on davietjal.org (fees change by session).
